inference_grades.rationale: The GM incorrectly inferred the team was focused on salary-neutral veteran swaps for positional balance, when the actual goal was to acquire any player rated 78+ regardless of salary or position.

The GM incorrectly inferred a salary dump motivation focused on tax avoidance and cap relief, when the actual goal was acquiring specific valuable assets (a 70+ rated player AND a future 1st) in exchange for a star player.

The GM correctly identified the key objective of acquiring defensive players to improve team defense, but missed the specific numerical threshold of needing two players with combined defense ratings >= 16 and the $15M net asset value constraint.

The GM correctly identified the key objectives of acquiring draft capital (first-round picks) and using cap space to absorb salary, but missed the specific numerical thresholds of needing at least 2 first-round picks and shedding at least $25M in committed salary.

The GM inferred the team wanted to create small amounts of cap space ($2-3M) when the actual goal required shedding $18M+ in salary to achieve $10M+ in cap room, which is completely wrong in scale and direction.
